priya: Heads-up — we're planning to bring up q8b-compact as a candidate for inference next Tue. Need a short plan for promptset de-id merge + golden refresh. Observed small tokenization shifts on long prompts during local quant tests.

benjamin: ok. can you paste the failing example?

priya: sure, gist: long multi-turn prompts with embedded code blocks sometimes split tokens differently after quant tokenizer fallback. ex: `for (i=0;i<10;i++) {` becomes extra subtoken in some runs. Not huge but affects rerank/eval recalls.

ana: re: de-id merge — we should run a fuzzyhash pass then an embedding similarity dedupe at 0.92 threshold. If fuzzyhash matches, skip. If embed sim > 0.95 mark for manual review.

vikram: labeler capacity — we have ~120 open micro-golden reviews. ETA to clear at current velocity ~4d. Can re-prioritize some into expedited queue if we tag them 'q8b-onboard'.

maya: for golden refresh criteria: pick 1k seeds stratified by token length (<=128,129-512,>512), preserve 200 prior gold cases for regression checks, add 300 new edgecases from recent logs (long prompts and code). Will run cross-model eval vs prod model and q8b.

priya: nice. can we automate the sample extraction? I can drop a tiny job.

labeler-bot: created ticket ML-9242 with linking sample lists: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-9242 — includes CSVs and tag fields (priority: high).

benjamin: quick sanity check command i'm using:
```bash
python scripts/sample_extract.py --min-tokens 20 --max-tokens 2048 --strata "0-128,129-512,513-2048" --output /tmp/q8b-seeds.csv
```

ana: after extraction run:
1) fuzzyhash dedupe
2) embedding cluster dedupe (faiss index)
3) hand 500 borderline to labelers

vikram: I'll bump labeler schedule, +2 reviewers tomorrow PM. ops-bot can you add a canary window?

ops-bot: scheduled q8b canary 2024-03-12T18:00Z - 2024-03-12T22:00Z in us-west1. Fallbacks: prod->v1.2 immediate.

priya: owners: ana for dedupe pipeline, maya for gold selection, benjamin for eval harness, vikram for labeler ops. I'll coordinate rollout doc.

maya: I'll prepare the eval dashboard (precision/recall by strata + hallucination checks) and share link by EOD tomorrow.

benjamin: will add tokenization regression test to the harness (unit + longctx smoke).

priya: perfect. if anyone sees a quick blocker ping me @priya. thanks :thumbsup:

ana: ack :wave:

vikram: acked, scheduling review blocks.

labeler-bot: labeler queue snapshot: 118 micro-golden tasks, 22 high-priority flagged. https://redwood.tools/labeler/queue

priya: closing loop here — will post the rollout doc and the sample CSVs in the ticket.

benjamin: thanks — i'll run the harness once samples are in.

maya: adding housekeeper note: keep previous golden set pinned for 2 weeks to measure regression deltas.

priya: noted. thanks everyone.
